title: A dangling story reference
concept: The design map still lists a story whose part has been removed from the archive. A reader that resolves every part the design map names finds nothing for this one; Paged stops with a MissingEntry error that names the path instead of guessing.

annotations.note: StoryList still names ustory as a story belonging to this document.
This idPkg:Story line points the loader at Stories/Story_ustory.xml — but that part no longer exists in the package. This is the dangling reference.

verified.reason: A pathological package on purpose: InDesign drops the unplaced story on open.
